availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Route 113/114 is reached after Mauville/Wattson (cap 30) via Route 111 -> Route 112 -> Fiery Path, per Game Book C20/C21. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113/114: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Route 114 is reached from Fallarbor per Game Book C20/C21. Adds Petalburg Woods (Heracross gate 14, Heracronite window 14) and NewMauville_Entrance (Magnezone gate 30).
plan: Lenny is a sound team: a Choice Specs Scrappy Exploud whose Boomburst ignores Ghost immunity, with two Soundproof partners (Mr. Mime, Hakamo-o) and a Telepathy Noibat so the spread never hits his own side. I have no Soundproof and no Wide Guard, so the answer is typing and speed: Excadrill and Magnezone are Steel and resist Boomburst outright, and the two highest-offset members are both 4x to something I carry - Noibat (Flying/Dragon) is 4x to Weavile's Ice, and Hakamo-o (Dragon/Fighting) is 4x to Togekiss's Dazzling Gleam. Noibat sits at offset +6, the highest in my whole block, but it is frail behind a Focus Sash, so Weavile's Triple Axel breaks the Sash and its Ice Shard closes. Leading Weavile beside Excadrill rather than Togekiss keeps a Boomburst resist on the field from turn one.
